SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [d360].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CI_LOAD]
( 
	[ACID] [varchar](30)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_ID] [varchar](9)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_SERIAL_NUMBER] [varchar](4)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_DATE] [date]  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_AMOUNT] [numeric](20,4)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP] [numeric](20,4)  NULL,
	[INITIALIZING_BRANCH_CODE] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_TYPE] [char](1)  NULL,
	[BRANCH_CODE] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_PARTICULAR] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_REMARKS] [varchar](30)  NULL,
	[CHANGED_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[CREATED_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[POSTED_DATE] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[FCBSCIF] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	[SK] [bigint] IDENTITY 
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO

SELECT 
     HTD.ACID
    ,HTD.TRAN_ID AS TRANSACTION_ID
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM AS TRANSACTION_SERIAL_NUMBER
    ,HTD.TRAN_DATE AS TRANSACTION_DATE
    ,HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE AS TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_AMT AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
    ,HTD.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP
    ,HTD.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID AS INITIALIZING_BRANCH_CODE
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE AS TRANSACTION_TYPE
    ,HTD.SOL_ID AS BRANCH_CODE
    ,HTD.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR AS TRANSACTION_PARTICULAR
    ,HTD.TRAN_RMKS AS TRANSACTION_REMARKS
    ,HTD.LCHG_TIME AS CHANGED_TIME
    ,HTD.RCRE_TIME AS CREATED_TIME
    ,HTD.PSTD_DATE AS POSTED_DATE
    ,HTD.BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
    ,CUST.ORGKEY AS FCBSCIF
